gloss: freely; at will; with complete mastery

cross_references.headword: {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}
cross_references.label: in all directions, without limit

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (freedom) and ⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧ (at will) for emphasis. Describes effortless mastery or unrestricted movement. Most commonly used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧: to wield freely, to command with mastery
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move freely
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}いこなす→使いこなす：07179_tsukaikonasu⟧: to use with complete skill
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: free, unrestricted movement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧: freely, at will — the second half alone, slightly more literary
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: free, freedom — broader meaning, not restricted to skill or mastery
- ⟦{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}→縦横無尽：14074_juuoumujin⟧: in all directions, without limit — emphasizes range and reach

definitions.gloss: freely; at will; with complete mastery
definitions.explanation: being able to do something freely and effortlessly, as one pleases; having complete control or mastery over something
